keyPhrases.text: their undercurrents made me relieved not to be sharing them: a nastiness, a disgust with ordinary humanity
I won a Golden Ticket... it meant I never had to visit and spoil our appetites for far richer fare
what was really needed, it seems, was a Broadway show
the only child onstage the audience could imagine spending any time with
the lyrics are stuffed with treacle
It also has a creepiness that Mr. Dahl clearly intended

reasoning: Harsh criticism throughout with fundamental disdain for source material. Reviewer expresses relief at avoiding the story, calls lyrics 'treacle,' and finds the show creepy and unpleasant. No genuine praise or recommendation.
